newsitem.title: UK: British Airways sets management changes.
newsitem.headline: British Airways sets management changes.

text.p: British Airways Plc said in a statement that Mike Street, currently director of operations, will become chief operating officer from January 1, 1997 to replace Alistair Cumming who retires in June 1997.

It said Charles Gurassa will become director of passenger and cargo businesses, and John Patterson will head BA's business efficiency programme, which aims to save 1.0 billion pounds over three years.
Colin Matthews will become managing director of the engineering division and the purchasing department will be headed by Jeannie Bevan.
Valerie Scoular, director of customer service, will head a new passenger policy group. ((-- London newsroom 44 171 542 7717 ))
